content.user_title: Finance Data Assets with Structured Guidance
content.value_statement: Organizations struggle to choose viable financing paths for recognized data assets. This skill structures financing, securitization, trust, insurance, cash flow, and tax analysis.
actual_capabilities: Compares bank pledge financing with asset-backed securitization.
Checks five ABS eligibility conditions and cash flow collectability.
Structures SPV, subordination, trust, insurance, and credit enhancement options.
Defines baseline and stress scenarios for coverage analysis.
Lists accounting, tax, due diligence, application, and servicing deliverables.
limitations: It does not issue legal, audit, rating, banking, trust, or insurance opinions.
It cannot guarantee credit approval, issuance success, pricing, or financing amounts.
Policy references and numeric benchmarks require current professional verification.
SKILL.md names a knowledge file that differs from the included file path.

use_cases.title: Choose a Financing Path
use_cases.description: Compare pledge financing and ABS using asset quality, ownership, cash flow, scale, and readiness.

use_cases.title: Design an ABS Structure
use_cases.description: Outline eligibility checks, cash flow scenarios, SPV structure, enhancement measures, and application materials.

use_cases.title: Assess Trust and Insurance Options
use_cases.description: Compare trust structures and insurance coverage while identifying tax, term, exclusion, and institutional constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Initial Financing Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether our recognized data asset may support financing. List the minimum information you need before recommending a path.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Financing Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare pledge financing and ABS for this asset. Evaluate ownership, cash flow, scale, timing, cost, and required evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build an ABS Framework
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ABS framework covering eligibility, cash flow collection, stress tests, SPV design, enhancement, tax, and application materials.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Full Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a multidisciplinary review of this proposal. Reconcile financing, modeling, trust, insurance, accounting, tax, and compliance findings.

output_examples.input: Our data asset is recognized, but revenue history covers only eighteen months.
output_examples.output: Prefer a pledge financing assessment. The available history is weaker than the knowledge base benchmark for predictable ABS cash flow.

output_examples.input: Design the work plan for a data asset ABS feasibility study.
output_examples.output: Start with ownership and collectability evidence. Then model three cash flow scenarios, test coverage, design enhancement, and map tax and application tasks.

output_examples.input: Should we use a trust and insurance together?
output_examples.output: Compare isolation benefits, insurable risks, exclusions, tax treatment, registration term, institutional experience, and total enhancement cost before selecting a combination.

best_practices: Provide ownership, accounting recognition, valuation, contracts, and historical cash flow evidence.
Verify all policy citations, thresholds, and tax assumptions against current professional advice.
Separate feasibility guidance from opinions reserved for licensed institutions.
anti_patterns: Do not assume accounting recognition guarantees financing eligibility.
Do not recommend ABS without stable, attributable, measurable, and verifiable cash flow.
Do not promise approval, issuance, ratings, pricing, or legal conclusions.

faq.question: Does recognized data automatically qualify for financing?
faq.answer: No. Lenders also assess ownership, asset quality, cash flow, valuation, controls, and repayment capacity.

faq.question: When is ABS more suitable than pledge financing?
faq.answer: ABS needs stable, collectable, transferable, durable, and sufficiently large cash flow. Pledge financing may fit weaker cash flow profiles.

faq.question: Can this skill calculate a final financing amount?
faq.answer: No. It can frame indicative ranges and assumptions, but institutions determine approved amounts and terms.

faq.question: Does the skill replace legal or tax advisers?
faq.answer: No. Licensed professionals must validate legal, accounting, audit, rating, and tax conclusions.

faq.question: What information should users provide?
faq.answer: Provide ownership records, accounting treatment, valuation, revenue contracts, collection data, customer concentration, costs, and financing objectives.

faq.question: Can it assess trust and insurance structures?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares trust roles, isolation, coverage types, exclusions, terms, tax effects, institutional readiness, and compatibility with financing.
